Source_identity_scope: Frozen worker base and final worker commit only; no equality claim about future Root Main.

instruction_operands.guarded_replay_limit: The pure replay independently decodes exact opcodes/ModRM/relative fields and checks retained Capstone operands; it does not load Capstone.

conditional_local_contract.scope: Conditional instruction-local x86 effects only; all addresses and arithmetic are 32-bit. Loads, stores, calls, and returns are assumed to complete normally only when tracing that path.
conditional_local_contract.saved_name_is_not_authentication: ___InternalCxxFrameHandler is saved metadata, not proof of CRT identity, original FH3, invocation contract, or callee ABI.

local_inputs_after_first_return.00C0799C: Compare DWORD[P+0x20C] with zero; intervening MOV instructions preserve these flags until JNZ at 00C079B8.
local_inputs_after_first_return.meaning: P, D and C are symbolic values from the unknown returned state; no descriptor, exception object, thread-state or version-field interpretation is authenticated.
local_inputs_after_first_return.conditional_frame_origin: Only if F0=H=S-4 and relevant incoming words remain intact, D comes from incoming [S+0x14] and C from incoming [S+4]. The outer wrapper opaque D is therefore a conditional composition, not an established binding. The earlier Original action EBP=storeESP+0x20 remains unbound.

local_routing_before_any_later_call.effects: Go to 00C079DA if DWORD[P+0x20C]!=0, DWORD[C]==K, DWORD[C]==0x80000026, or (DWORD[D]&mask)<V unsigned; otherwise byte[D+0x20]&1 nonzero goes to fixed-one 00C07A6D and zero falls through to 00C079DA.
If byte[C+4]&0x66 is nonzero, DWORD[D+4]==0 or DWORD[F0+0x1C]!=0 goes to fixed-one; otherwise take four-push direct call at 00C079F9. If the byte mask is zero, go to 00C07A03.
DWORD[D+0xC]!=0 goes to 00C07A1B. Otherwise (DWORD[D]&mask)<0x19930521 unsigned or DWORD[D+0x1C]==0 goes to fixed-one; all other paths go to 00C07A1B.

DWORD[C]!=K, DWORD[C+0x10]<3 unsigned, or DWORD[C+0x14]<=V unsigned goes to default direct call setup 00C07A51. Otherwise load EDX=DWORD[DWORD[C+0x1C]+8]; zero goes to default setup, nonzero goes to computed call setup 00C07A34.

conditional_local_contract.outgoing_argument_alias_rule: All frame loads Loffset@N below occur at their actual instruction, after N earlier argument pushes. Q0 and F0 are unrelated unknowns; outgoing push stores can alias later frame loads. Do not substitute frozen incoming argument values without an explicit nonalias and intact-memory assumption. D and C remain register values until the selected call. The target EDX and U8 are loaded before computed-route pushes.

later_calls.continuation: ADD ESP,0x10 then JMP 00C07A6D; Z=Q1+0x10, EAX becomes 1.

later_calls.computed_target: EDX loaded from DWORD[DWORD[C+0x1C]+8] before any argument push; target address is not read or followed.
later_calls.continuation: ADD ESP,0x20 then JMP 00C07A70, skipping fixed-one; Z=Q2+0x20 and EAX=A2.
ADD ESP,0x20 falls through to fixed-one; Z=Q3+0x20 and EAX becomes 1.

shared_suffix.pop_ret: 00C07A70..00C07A74: POP EDI; POP ESI; POP EBX; POP EBP; RET. There is no MOV ESP,EBP.
shared_suffix.Z: Q0 if no later call; Q1+0x10 after the four-push call; Q2+0x20 after computed call; Q3+0x20 after default call.
shared_suffix.EAX: 1 except the computed-call path, which carries unknown returned A2.
shared_suffix.unknowns: Later returned F1/F2/F3 are unused before POP EBP. Actual return target and restored values remain unknown across external calls.
shared_suffix.conditional_ordinary_restoration: If first return Q0=S-0x10, each selected later call returns Qi=Q0-argument_bytes (0x10 or 0x20), and original saved register/return words remain intact, then Z=S-0x10, B/X/I/J are restored, RET reads original [S], and final ESP=S+4. F0=H is an additional condition for original frame-word origins, not a consequence of stack balance.
